```{r}
library(devtools)
## Install CS-CORE from Github
#install_github("ChangSuBiostats/CS-CORE")
library(CSCORE)
```


```{r}
table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$final.clones)
ss$celltype.final.clones
ss <- subset(t.cells, orig.ident == "S101")
ss.malig <- subset(ss, celltype.final.clones == "Malignant")
ss.non.malig <- subset(ss, celltype.final.clones == "T/NK_Cells")



mean_exp = rowMeans(ss.malig@assays$RNA@layers$data/ss.malig$nCount_RNA)
names(mean_exp) <- rownames(ss.malig)
genes_selected = names(sort.int(mean_exp, decreasing = T))[1:5000]

CSCORE_result <- CSCORE(ss.malig, genes = genes_selected)

# Obtain CS-CORE co-expression estimates
CSCORE_coexp <- CSCORE_result$est

# Obtain BH-adjusted p values
CSCORE_p <- CSCORE_result$p_value
p_matrix_BH = matrix(0, length(genes_selected), length(genes_selected))
p_matrix_BH[upper.tri(p_matrix_BH)] = p.adjust(CSCORE_p[upper.tri(CSCORE_p)], method = "BH")
p_matrix_BH <- p_matrix_BH + t(p_matrix_BH)

# Set co-expression entires with BH-adjusted p-values greater than 0.05 to 0
CSCORE_coexp
CSCORE_coexp[p_matrix_BH > 0.05] <- 0

threshold <- 0.95
min_count <- 30
CSCORE_coexp.ss <- CSCORE_coexp[apply(abs(CSCORE_coexp), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count, apply(abs(CSCORE_coexp), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count]

pheatmap(CSCORE_coexp.ss, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)
```


```{r}
mean_exp = rowMeans(ss.non.malig@assays$RNA@layers$data/ss.non.malig$nCount_RNA)
names(mean_exp) <- rownames(ss.non.malig)
genes_selected = names(sort.int(mean_exp, decreasing = T))[1:5000]

CSCORE_result.non.malig <- CSCORE(ss.non.malig, genes = genes_selected)

# Obtain CS-CORE co-expression estimates
CSCORE_coexp.non.malig <- CSCORE_result.non.malig$est

# Obtain BH-adjusted p values
CSCORE_p.non.malig <- CSCORE_result.non.malig$p_value
p_matrix_BH.non.malig = matrix(0, length(genes_selected), length(genes_selected))
p_matrix_BH.non.malig[upper.tri(p_matrix_BH.non.malig)] = p.adjust(CSCORE_p.non.malig[upper.tri(CSCORE_p.non.malig)], method = "BH")
p_matrix_BH.non.malig <- p_matrix_BH.non.malig + t(p_matrix_BH.non.malig)

# Set co-expression entires with BH-adjusted p-values greater than 0.05 to 0
CSCORE_coexp.non.malig[p_matrix_BH.non.malig > 0.05] <- 0

threshold <- 0.95
min_count <- 30
CSCORE_coexp.non.malig.ss <- CSCORE_coexp.non.malig[apply(abs(CSCORE_coexp.non.malig), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count, apply(abs(CSCORE_coexp.non.malig), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count]

pheatmap(CSCORE_coexp.non.malig.ss, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)
```





```{r}
cscore.dif <- CSCORE_coexp - CSCORE_coexp.non.malig

cscore.dif[p_matrix_BH > 0.05] <- 0
cscore.dif[p_matrix_BH.non.malig > 0.05] <- 0

threshold <- .9
min_count <- 10
cscore.dif.ss <- cscore.dif[apply(abs(cscore.dif), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count, apply(abs(cscore.dif), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count]

pheatmap(cscore.dif.ss, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)
```

```{r}
threshold <- 0.99
min_count <- 100

CSCORE_coexp.non.malig.ss <- CSCORE_coexp.non.malig[apply(abs(CSCORE_coexp.non.malig), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count, apply(abs(CSCORE_coexp.non.malig), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count]

CSCORE_coexp.ss <- CSCORE_coexp[apply(abs(CSCORE_coexp), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count, apply(abs(CSCORE_coexp), 1, function(x) sum(x > threshold)) >= min_count]

pheatmap(CSCORE_coexp.non.malig.ss, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)
pheatmap(CSCORE_coexp.ss, cluster_cols = T, cluster_rows = T)
```
